candidate_text: Thunder Nova: The Archmage of the Ember Order unleashes a radial burst around themself, hurling servants of the Ash King back and carving out emergency breathing room. Whispered to stir the dust of cursed relics. Long cooldown between castings.

evaluation.reason: The candidate renames Force Wave to "Thunder Nova" and buries the mechanic under invented lore (Archmage, Ember Order, Ash King, cursed relics) that the task context does not support, so it reads as generic heroic fantasy rather than No Safe Circle.

violations.explanation: The canonical ability name is Force Wave; renaming it for flavor violates the requirement to use established game terms and the explicit content requirement to use the canonical name.
violations.revision_instruction: Replace "Thunder Nova" with "Force Wave" as the ability name.

violations.explanation: The canonical player term is "wizard"; "Archmage" is an invented player title not established by the GDD or task context.
violations.revision_instruction: Replace "Archmage" with "wizard" or rephrase to avoid naming the player with an invented title.

violations.explanation: The Ember Order is an invented faction with no support in the supplied task context or canonical GDD.
violations.revision_instruction: Remove the reference to the Ember Order entirely.

violations.explanation: The Ash King is an invented antagonist/faction not established anywhere in the supplied content requirements or task context.
violations.revision_instruction: Replace "servants of the Ash King" with the canonical enemy terminology (e.g., Melee Enemy/Ranged Enemy or a generic "enemies") without inventing a named antagonist.

violations.problematic_text: Whispered to stir the dust of cursed relics.
violations.explanation: This introduces invented lore (cursed relics, whispered legend) with no basis in the supported facts, adding unsupported worldbuilding to a short spell tooltip.
violations.revision_instruction: Delete this sentence; it adds unsupported lore and unnecessary flavor to a concise tooltip.
